sources.title: chrismattmann/pantogloss-500-en-fp16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is the released FP16 variant of Panto-500, a many-to-English translation model for Pantogloss. It is a deterministic IEEE-754 binary16 conversion of released float32 model version 0.1.0.
